scope: Single bounded experimental MG24/C6 receive-only event correlation
status: Investigation complete; original strict RF assessment remains failed
observer_effect: Additional sync/filter/abort callbacks and RAM trace stores alter instrumentation load; not production qualification.

trace.callback_measurement_limit: Entry through original handler, excludes final bookkeeping; not isolated added overhead or WCET

alignment.selection: Unique exact39-byte shared MACs with valid normalized MG frame end, consistent raw position6, <=100ms hostdelivery separation, one-second inward trim and both queues zero
alignment.coverage: Six of seven C6-only forwarded observations inside anchor bounds; seventh excluded, no extrapolation

findings.four_covered_misses: Predicted PHR-through-FCS interval overlaps anonymous MG24 frame-error episode; one also overlaps an early abort
findings.one_covered_miss: 52us sync-to-abort episode near predicted start; packet identity unknown

one_covered_miss_competing_frame.description: MG24 accepts a different original-FCS-valid forwarded frame while C6 accepts the unmatched forwarded frame. Same MAC sequence and application subject, different MAC source/destination and body bytes.
one_covered_miss_competing_frame.assumption: 250kbit/s PHY; PHR+MAC+FCS42bytes takes1344us; excludes preamble/SFD. C6 callback clock mapped to MG hardware-end clock.
one_covered_miss_competing_frame.interpretation: Supports competing transmissions/capture effects for this observed case, not a UART or portable-queue disappearance.

limitations: Anonymous events have no packet bytes; temporal coincidence is not packet identity or causal proof.
Observed residual envelope is not a hard timing bound; accepted-event offsets may differ from error/abort timing.
The clock model is validated on shared frames; unusual C6 callback latency for an unmatched frame cannot be excluded and would change estimated overlap.
Early aborts and corrupted lengths can end before/after the expected frame end.
No sent denominator, no loss probability, no production qualification. Added diagnostic interrupts may affect reception.
One frozen30s attempt only; original strict failure remains failed.
Neither radio supplies the count of actual transmitted frames; packet-loss probability cannot be inferred.
This does not establish that all ambient or production-network errors share the same cause.
next_step_not_executed: Separately reviewed controlled overlap experiment using only non-production transmitters: known unique payloads, clean single-transmitter baseline, then prescribed relative timing/received-power changes with independent capture. Requires suitable spare hardware; no production switches/radios changed in this stage.

post_trial_quality_followup.scope: Comment clarifications and maximum-index/full-store regression only; runtime C token streams unchanged from frozen V3
post_trial_quality_followup.native_gcc: 14.2.0, all6 tests pass at O2 with Wformat2/Werror/ASAN/UBSAN
